overview: FootballHEIR is a fully on-chain, DAO-governed football database on the Internet Computer. Every table, column, rule, page, and API endpoint is created and managed by ICFC token holders via on-chain proposals. Now includes a public documentation hub covering DAO governance, developer guides, API client onboarding, and genesis bootstrap instructions.
features: Public documentation hub at /docs with sidebar navigation
Pre-seeded docs: ICP Coding Standards, Project Conventions, DAO Bootstrap Guide, Genesis Validation Guide
Real-time search filtering by title and content
Mobile-responsive sidebar with dark mode support
Full DAO governance with 33 proposal types
Pay-as-you-go API with key management and analytics
ICFC token staking, voting, and burn mechanics
